Titles.jpn: ワンピースフィルムゴールド

Summaries.eng: Gran Tesoro is the home of the world's greatest entertainment city for well-known pirates, Marines, and millionaires. Drawn by the dream of winning the bigger prize, Captain Luffy and his crew navigate directly to find gold. But a powerful king with even bigger ambitious will cause a potential enormous disaster for the Straw Hat Pirates and the New World.
